## Public API

### `influx.schemas`
- class `Tier3Extraction` — Tier-3 deep extraction output validated against FR-ENR-5 (PRD 07 §5.3).
- class `Tier1Enrichment` — Tier-1 enrichment output validated against FR-ENR-4 (PRD 07 §5.2).
- class `FilterResult` — One scored item from the LLM filter response (FR-FLT-3).
- class `FilterResponse` — Top-level wrapper for a batch of filter results (FR-FLT-3).
- def `openai_strict_response_format` — Return an OpenAI ``response_format`` dict pinning *schema_class*.
